source.prompt: A flat, front-on decorative panel, square, 2048x2048, on a solid flat bright magenta background (#ff00ff). Orthographic, flat, even, shadowless lighting, as if scanned: no highlights, no cast shadows, no vignette, no shading gradient across the image. No perspective, no objects, no text, no border, no watermark. The pattern must repeat: the left edge continues into the right edge and the top into the bottom. Material: Tibetan Cham ritual carved bone-bead apron lattice (rgyan drug) in a four-by-four diagonal diamond net: round carved ivory-bone wheel-rosette junction plaques (#ebe4d2) accented with tiny gilded brass (#d4a838) and dark maroon-cord (#581418) knots, linked by diagonal double strands of turned cylindrical bone beads; every diamond opening between the bone strands shows only the solid flat bright magenta background (#ff00ff). Hard clean edges against the magenta (#ff00ff), no anti-aliased fringe of other colours. No magenta, pink or purple anywhere in the subject.
